reason: $325 is a lot for a toddler's party when I can do it at home or a park pavilion for under $100 and the kid won't remember it either way. It also opens next year and my birthday is coming up in the next few months.
objection: $325 for two hours for a little kid is a lot, and it isn't even open yet for the date I need.
would_change_my_mind: A Basic price closer to $200 and a confirmed opening date before my kid's birthday.
